expectations.text: The Adel prompt explicitly specifies a gray / neutral-gray background for the character sheet
expectations.evidence: Adel prompt opens with 'Character reference sheet on a solid mid-gray studio background, even soft lighting.' QA checklist also enforces it: 'Background actually solid mid-gray?'

expectations.text: The Adel prompt requests multiple views on one sheet, including a clear face close-up AND a full-body view showing the outfit
expectations.evidence: One sheet with 'Three views of the same character': '[1] front-facing close-up portrait of the face, [2] full-body front view showing the complete outfit, [3] full-body three-quarter back view'.

expectations.text: The goblin prompt requests 3 or more distinct variations of the goblin type (different builds/heights/gear) rather than a single goblin
expectations.evidence: 'Four distinct variations of a goblin minion standing side by side... each differing in height, build, ear shape, posture, and gear wear' with four enumerated builds ([1] short pot-bellied ... [4] scrawny runt).

expectations.text: The response includes accept/reject QA criteria for evaluating the generated sheets (e.g., cross-view consistency, face clarity)
expectations.evidence: Two 'QA checklist — accept or reject' sections, e.g. 'Same girl in every view? Face shape, curl pattern... must match across all three views. Any drift → reject' and 'Face view clear and large? ... if it's small, soft, or shadowed → reject.'

eval_feedback.overall: Assertions are discriminating for this skill's core mechanics (gray background, view layout, group variation, QA gates). No suggestions.
